post.description: Records money the merchant collected directly — cash, check, Zelle, and similar. There is no processor to wait on, so the allocation is applied and the invoice balance moves in the same request: a partial amount leaves the invoice `partially_paid`, and the full remaining balance marks it `paid`. Note that `effectiveAt` drives the invoice `paidAt`, so back-dating a cash payment back-dates the paid date. The recording actor is taken from the authenticated principal and is never accepted in the body. Idempotent by idempotency key per invoice.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Invoice TypeID (`inv_...`) the payment applies to.

requestBody.description: Out-of-band payload with idempotency key, merchant scope, method, and optional amount, effective date, and reference.

checkPartial.summary: Check, partial amount with check number

zelleBackDated.summary: Zelle, back-dated to when the transfer landed

201.description: Payment recorded. Returns the invoice with its balance already updated, plus the `applied` allocation.

400.description: Validation failed, invoice is not `issued` or `partially_paid`, amount exceeds the remaining balance, `effectiveAt` is in the future, or `method` is `other` without a reference.

403.description: Authenticated principal lacks `invoices.update` capability or merchant scope.

404.description: Invoice was not found for the provided merchant scope.

409.description: Concurrent payment activity kept moving the balance while this request was in flight. Re-read the invoice and retry — the remaining balance may now differ.

post.summary: Record a payment received outside PayGood

post.description: Unwinds an out-of-band payment that was recorded in error, dropping the invoice back to `partially_paid` or `issued` depending on the remaining balance. The allocation is kept as `reversed` rather than deleted so the audit trail survives. Only `out_of_band` allocations can be reversed — a processed payment moved real funds and must be refunded instead.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Invoice TypeID (`inv_...`) the allocation belongs to.

parameters.name: allocationId
parameters.description: Invoice payment allocation TypeID (`invpay_...`) to reverse.

requestBody.description: Reversal payload with merchant scope. No idempotency key: only an `applied` allocation can be reversed, so a replay is rejected rather than duplicated.

reverseCashEntry.summary: Reverse a cash entry recorded in error

200.description: Payment reversed. Returns the invoice with its balance reduced, plus the `reversed` allocation.

400.description: Allocation is a processed `payment` (refund it instead) or is not currently `applied`.

403.description: Authenticated principal lacks `invoices.update` capability or merchant scope.

404.description: Invoice or allocation was not found for the provided merchant scope.

409.description: Concurrent payment activity kept moving the balance while this request was in flight. Re-read the invoice and retry.

Returns the allowlist of merchant category codes (MCCs) for the signup business profile dropdown.

**Authentication:** Requires an authenticated member session. Send the `pg_member` httpOnly cookie obtained from `POST /member-auth/otp/verify`. Requests without a valid session receive `401 Unauthorized`.

**Signup flow:**
1. Authenticate the merchant via member OTP (`POST /member-auth/otp/request`, then `POST /member-auth/otp/verify`).
2. Call this endpoint to populate the MCC dropdown.
3. When saving the business profile, submit the selected entry's `code` as `businessProfile.mcc` on `PATCH /merchant-applications/:id/business-profile`. Only codes returned by this endpoint are accepted.

**Response shape:** JSON array ordered for display. Each item has `code` (wire value) and `displayName` (UI label).

200.description: Supported merchant category codes for onboarding. Use `code` when patching the merchant application business profile.

401.description: Missing or invalid member session. Authenticate via `POST /member-auth/otp/verify` and include the `pg_member` session cookie on the request.
